name: CA-44
label: Safe D

key_factors: Barragán's incumbency and large financial advantage
Prediction markets price near-certain Democratic win
model.rationale: The +20 Democratic lean, Barragán's incumbency, and a roughly 50-to-1 cash advantage over Genevieve Angel leave no evidence pointing toward an upset, and markets price the race at about 97% Democratic. The forecast stays at a Safe D margin near 25 points.
model.watch: Only a major late scandal or unexpected outside spending surge could put this seat in play.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Nanette Barragán seeks another term in a Los Angeles-area district that leans about 20 points Democratic. She advanced to the general election with a large financial edge, holding more than $1 million on hand, while Republican Genevieve Angel has raised under $14,000 and has no outside support on record. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets price Barragán's chances at roughly 97 percent.

The fundamentals strongly favor the incumbent: the district's partisan lean, her incumbency bonus, and her fundraising advantage all point the same direction. Barring an unforeseen development, this seat is expected to remain comfortably in Democratic hands in November.
